title: Grade 2 Science — Tue, Jun 02
description: Plants Around Us — Day 2 of 5: Types of plants
subject: science

questions.question: A very big plant with a hard, thick stem is called a:
questions.explanation: Trees are the largest plants with thick, hard, woody stems called trunks.

questions.question: A small plant with a soft, green stem is called a:
questions.explanation: Herbs are small plants with soft, green stems, like mint and coriander.

questions.question: A plant that needs support to climb up is called a:
questions.explanation: Climbers, like a money plant or grapevine, are weak and need support to climb.

questions.question: A medium plant with many woody branches near the ground is a:
questions.explanation: Shrubs are bushy plants with hard stems branching out close to the ground, like a rose plant.

questions.question: A plant with a weak stem that spreads along the ground is a:
questions.explanation: Creepers, like pumpkin and watermelon plants, have weak stems that creep along the ground.

questions.question: Which of these is a tree?
questions.explanation: Mango is a large tree with a thick woody trunk.

questions.question: Which of these is a herb?
questions.explanation: Tulsi (Basil) is a small herb with a soft stem.

questions.question: A grapevine climbing on a wall is an example of a:
questions.explanation: A grapevine is a climber — its weak stem climbs up with support.

questions.question: Which plant has the strongest stem?
questions.explanation: Trees have the strongest, thickest and hardest stems among all plants.

questions.question: A rose plant is an example of a:
questions.explanation: A rose plant is a shrub — bushy with hard stems branching near the ground.

questions.question: A watermelon plant spreading on the ground is a:
questions.explanation: A watermelon plant is a creeper that spreads along the ground.

questions.question: Which type of plant lives the longest and grows the tallest?
questions.explanation: Trees grow the tallest and can live for many, many years.

questions.question: Why does a money plant need a stick or thread to grow up a wall?
options: Its stem is weak and cannot stand on its own
questions.explanation: A money plant is a climber with a weak stem, so it needs support to climb.

questions.question: Coriander and mint are examples of:
questions.explanation: Coriander and mint are small herbs with soft green stems.

questions.question: Which group is in order from smallest to largest plant?
questions.explanation: Herbs are smallest, shrubs are medium-sized, and trees are the largest.
